notLevied.why: 4200: no net wealth tax: Constitution of the UAE (1971, as amended 2009) art. 133: no federal tax may be imposed, amended or abolished except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_United_Arab_Emirates_2009.txt); no federal law and no Dubai law (model emirate) levies it; federal tax laws read: Federal Decree-Law 8/2017 (VAT), 7/2017 (excise), 47/2022 (corporate tax); Dubai ECR 30/2013 (registration fees). convention R5-3k-G (Gulf state, no closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3k).

4300: no inheritance, estate or gift tax: Constitution of the UAE (1971, as amended 2009) art. 133: no federal tax may be imposed, amended or abolished except by law (Constitute Project English text, law/cp_United_Arab_Emirates_2009.txt); no federal law and no Dubai law (model emirate) levies it; federal tax laws read: Federal Decree-Law 8/2017 (VAT), 7/2017 (excise), 47/2022 (corporate tax); Dubai ECR 30/2013 (registration fees). convention R5-3k-G (Gulf state, no closed list of taxes): the constitution reserves taxes to law and no law in force levies this tax (the state's tax laws read in this build are listed); grade A for the clause (text read), the negative rests on that convention (pass 3k).
